description_en: Queries information about clients that have established SSL-VPN connections to Alibaba Cloud under a specified VPN gateway instance by calling the DescribeSslVpnClients operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeSslVpnClients接口查询指定VPN网关实例下已与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接的客户端的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-clients --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-gw8gfb947ctddabja0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSslVpnClients

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页可显示的最大条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

CommonName.description_en:
The SSL client certificate used when the client establishes an SSL-VPN connection to Alibaba Cloud.

If the client uses two-factor identity authentication to establish an SSL-VPN connection to Alibaba Cloud, the value of this parameter is the username of the client
CommonName.description_zh:
客户端与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接时，使用的SSL客户端证书。

如果客户端使用双因子认证功能与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接，则当前参数的返回值为客户端的用户名

ConnectedTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the client establishes an SSL-VPN connection to Alibaba Cloud. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp is in the UNIX format and represents the total duration from 00:00:00 on January 1, 1970 (UTC) to the time when the SSL-VPN connection is established
ConnectedTime.description_zh:
客户端与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接时的时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至建立SSL-VPN连接时的总时长

Ip.description_en: The public IP address that the client uses when establishing an SSL-VPN connection to Alibaba Cloud
Ip.description_zh: 客户端与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接时，客户端实际使用的公网IP地址

Port.description_en: The port number that the client uses when establishing an SSL-VPN connection to Alibaba Cloud
Port.description_zh: 客户端与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接时，客户端实际使用的端口号

PrivateIp.description_en: The private IP address that the VPN gateway assigns to the client when the client establishes an SSL-VPN connection to Alibaba Cloud
PrivateIp.description_zh: 客户端与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接时，VPN网关为客户端分配的私网IP地址

ReceiveBytes.description_en: The traffic that the VPN gateway receives from the client over the SSL-VPN connection. Unit: bytes
ReceiveBytes.description_zh: 指VPN网关通过SSL-VPN连接从客户端接收的流量。单位：Byte

SendBytes.description_en: The traffic that the VPN gateway sends to the client over the SSL-VPN connection. Unit: bytes
SendBytes.description_zh: 指VPN网关通过SSL-VPN连接向客户端发送的流量。单位：Byte

Status.description_en:
The status of the SSL-VPN connection.

Valid values: online, which indicates that the client has successfully established an SSL-VPN connection to Alibaba Cloud
Status.description_zh:
SSL-VPN连接的状态。

取值：online，表示客户端和阿里云已成功建立SSL-VPN连接

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页可显示的最大条目数

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the VPN gateway instance

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
